Orphan descriptions we can fix with a label

These are shrine items carrying a description in a language with no label in that language — and for which shinto-label-generator/ has already generated the missing label.

On Wikidata the uniqueness constraint is on the (label, description) pair, so a description with no label stakes the half that matters least and can get the eventual label edit rejected: a description with no label costs a label. audit_orphan_descriptions.py therefore removes such descriptions. That is right only where no label exists. Every row below is an orphan we can fix instead of clear — step 2 of the four-step path in docs/description_label_policy.md.
